newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end weak, more downside seen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end weak, more downside seen.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended easier in thin, lacklustre trading on Monday and dealers said the market looked set to head further south in the near term.
After hitting a low of 20,785, the benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract ended 120 points down at 20,840. Market turnover was a meagre 12,645 lots.
Dealers said the market's non-reaction to the release of Japan's October trade data and the lack of fresh leads or developments in the government's financial reform plan hampered interest.
"Technically, it's not looking very friendly in the short-term," said a trader with a local futures house, adding that the market could test a key support level at 20,750.
"If the 20,750 level can hold for one or two days and we can close near 21,000, we should be okay. Otherwise it'll probably go lower," he said.
Bargain-hunting interest is expected to prop the December Nikkei at the psychologically supported level of 20,500/550.
